text:
glasses_felix: I assumed it stayed at desk_b1 or moved to coffee_table_l1 based on Felix's study routine. Actually, it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1 in the morning, coffee_table_l1 in the evening, and nightstand_b1 late at night. Pattern: Felix moves his glasses frequently between rooms as he moves through his day. Check bathroom, living room, and bedroom nightstand in sequence based on time of day.

glass_felix: I assumed it was in the kitchen (dish_rack or table). Actually, it was at kitchen_table_k1 in the afternoon but moved to nightstand_b1 late at night. Pattern: Felix takes his drinking glass to his bedroom at night. Check nightstand_b1 for evening/night queries.

water_bottle_felix: I assumed it was in the kitchen (dish_rack). Actually, it was at kitchen_table_k1. Pattern: Felix keeps his water bottle at the kitchen table, not the sink or rack. Check kitchen_table_k1 first.

mug_felix: I assumed it was at desk_b1. Actually, it was at coffee_table_l1. Pattern: Felix uses the living room coffee table for his mug, not his desk. Check coffee_table_l1.

General Note: My assumption that Felix’s items remain static at his desk (desk_b1) is incorrect. He distributes his personal items (glasses, mug, glass, bottle) across the house (bathroom, kitchen table, coffee table, nightstand) depending on his activity and time of day. Do not default to desk_b1.
